clusters.headline: Nvidia Launches Independent Probe Into CEO Alleged Espionage Risks
aiSummaryBullets: Nvidia's board has initiated an independent inquiry into reports that CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by Chinese intelligence.
The investigation follows reports of a personal relationship between Huang and an executive allegedly linked to Beijing's information gathering.

clusters.headline: Hong Kong Activist Joshua Wong Sentenced To Ten Years In Prison
aiSummaryBullets: Hong Kong courts have sentenced prominent activist Joshua Wong to ten years in prison.
The sentencing follows conviction on charges related to collusion with foreign forces.
